job.job_description:
Engineering Manager – Generative AI

We're looking for a hands-on technical leader who is first and foremost a strong engineering manager — someone who has built and shipped high-scale production systems — and who has also gone deep on applying GenAI/LLMs to real product features. You'll lead a team building Java/Python applications with embedded generative AI capabilities, balancing hands-on technical leadership with people management.

Key Responsibilities

Lead end-to-end delivery of Java/Python applications with embedded GenAI features, staying hands-on in design and code reviews, not just oversight
Manage, mentor, and grow a team of backend and GenAI engineers
Drive technical strategy and architecture decisions across the GenAI stack
Own project timelines, resourcing, and budget for your team's roadmap
Partner with cross-functional teams (product, data, platform) to align GenAI initiatives with business goals
Set and enforce standards for code quality, testing, and deployment
Stay current on GenAI and broader engineering advancements, and bring relevant techniques into the team's practice

Requirements

8+ years building and deploying high-scale engineering applications, with a strong background in Java
2+ years managing/mentoring engineers
Track record of shipping GenAI products end to end, from prototype to production
Hands-on experience with at least one SQL database; NoSQL experience is a plus
Proficiency in Python, with experience in at least one framework (Flask, FastAPI, or Django)
Practical experience applying GenAI in production: prompting techniques, RAG, and LLM serving frameworks

Nice to Have

Experience with Elasticsearch or another search/vector database
Experience with agent frameworks (LangGraph, AutoGen, or similar)
Working knowledge of NLP concepts and small/large language models 

Desired Attributes

Strong problem-solving instincts and comfort operating with ambiguity
Excellent communication and leadership skills
Ability to balance technical depth with strategic, business-facing thinking
Comfortable with agile delivery and cross-functional project management
